title.rendered: 18th birthday (debut) – ChinaStix Restaurant, Santa Clara – Saturday, December 28, 2013

content.rendered:
ChinaStix Restaurant, 3284 El Camino Real, Santa Clara, CA 95051.
5:30 PM – 10:00 PM.

Bay Area Filipino DJ Debutante – San Jose, California Todo-todo,Achy Breaky Heart, Zorba, Cha Cha.

Zorba Line Dance
